content: Compare the quotes on the Dubois Household - Personal Auto sale: premium and deductible for each.

name: query_salesforce

content:
[Dubois Household - Personal Auto](/lightning/r/006aj00000elPs5AAE/view) has two quotes. Both are Presented, so both are waiting on the customer, and both have a **$100,000** limit.

| Quote | Annual premium | Deductible |
|---|---|---|
| [Higher deductible, lower premium](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aZgoCAE/view) | **$1,435** | $2,000 |
| [Standard deductible](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aZgnCAE/view) | **$1,560** | $1,000 |

The higher-deductible option saves **$125 a year** in exchange for $1,000 more paid out of pocket on each claim.
